import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    readings = inputs["readings"]

    df = readings.copy()

    # Row-level bad rule: value IS NULL OR value < 0 OR value > 1000
    value_num = pd.to_numeric(df["value"], errors="coerce")
    is_null = df["value"].isna()
    is_bad = is_null | (value_num < 0) | (value_num > 1000)
    df["_is_bad"] = is_bad

    # Batch-level aggregation
    batch_stats = (
        df.groupby("batch_id")["_is_bad"]
        .agg(bad_count="sum", total_count="count")
        .reset_index()
    )
    batch_stats["bad_count"] = batch_stats["bad_count"].astype("int64")
    batch_stats["total_count"] = batch_stats["total_count"].astype("int64")

    batch_stats["_quarantine"] = (
        batch_stats["bad_count"] * 100 > batch_stats["total_count"] * 20
    )
    batch_stats["batch_reject_pct"] = (
        batch_stats["bad_count"] * 100.0 / batch_stats["total_count"]
    ).round(2)

    df = df.merge(
        batch_stats[["batch_id", "_quarantine", "batch_reject_pct"]],
        on="batch_id",
        how="left",
    )

    orig_cols = list(readings.columns)

    quarantine_mask = df["_quarantine"]
    quarantine_df = df.loc[quarantine_mask, orig_cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]].copy()

    non_quarantine = df.loc[~quarantine_mask].copy()

    clean_df = non_quarantine.loc[~non_quarantine["_is_bad"], orig_cols].copy()
    rejects_df = non_quarantine.loc[non_quarantine["_is_bad"], orig_cols].copy()

    clean_df = clean_df.reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects_df = rejects_df.reset_index(drop=True)
    quarantine_df = quarantine_df.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "readings_clean": clean_df,
        "readings_rejects": rejects_df,
        "readings_quarantine": quarantine_df,
    }
